scatter-chart.stories.ts's Default story changed its x-label/y-label from single letters ("X"/"Y") to "X value"/"Y value" -- a rotated single capital letter is inherently illegible (reads as a generic chevron regardless of font), which multi-character labels fix. The current capture reflects that intentional demo-data change and awaits human visual review.

chart.class.ts's buildScales() now sets the radial (r) scale's ticks.z: 1 so Chart.js draws ring labels after datasets instead of before, fixing labels (e.g. "20"/"15") being partly painted over by data wedges. The current capture reflects that fix and awaits human visual review.

box-plot.class.ts now applies the resolved --lr-chart-grid-color and --lr-chart-tick-color to the x axis as well as the y axis, replacing Chart.js defaults with the documented theme contract. The current capture reflects that intentional consistency fix and awaits human visual review.

Current capture renders a structurally valid but differently-moduled QR code for the same unchanged story value, with no corresponding qr-code.class.ts/story change since the last baseline refresh (bd4ac0ac) -- likely resolved-version drift in the optional qrcode peer, not a lyra-ui source change. Awaits human visual review.

The idle-state bar fill swapped from --lr-color-brand-quiet (a subtle panel-fill token, ~1.1-1.3:1 contrast against the surface) to --lr-color-brand-border-normal (~4:1 in both themes), fixing a WCAG 1.4.11 non-text contrast failure. The current capture reflects that fix and awaits human visual review.

The v8 markdown API replaced the sanitize boolean with a tri-state html-mode attribute; the story copy now documents html-mode="trusted" instead of .sanitize=${false}. The current capture reflects that intentional content change and awaits human visual review.

item-chunk-count/item-embedding-status/item-attempts now carry unicode-bidi: plaintext, fixing RTL word/digit reordering in their status text (e.g. "26 of 48 chunks embedded" no longer reordering). The current rtl capture reflects that fix and awaits human visual review.

lr-conversation-item's excerpt template now renders its fallback text node before the (usually empty) excerpt <slot>, fixing a dir="auto" first-strong-character detection bug where the preceding empty <slot> element caused Chromium to fall back to the ambient RTL host direction instead of the excerpt's own (English) content -- which silently flipped text-overflow: ellipsis truncation to the wrong end of the string under RTL. The current rtl capture reflects that fix and awaits human visual review.

The virtualized cell's stream-output part now carries direction: ltr; unicode-bidi: isolate, matching the code-input block rendered above it, instead of inheriting the ambient RTL host direction and right-aligning independently of the input. The current rtl capture reflects that fix and awaits human visual review.
